sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the required ship-level direct calculation: all declared operands and result terms are present with QuantityValue and kN constraints, the forward and backward formulas are correct, both directional design-thrust results and the common design-thrust result are compared to the same max-derived expected value, and inclusive tolerances are scaled from expected results without imposing an undeclared numeric datatype.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Correct the design-thrust comparison: the requirement takes the greater of forwardPropellerShaftDesignThrust = hydrodynamicBollardThrust + 2.2*forwardIceThrust and backwardPropellerShaftDesignThrust = 1.5*backwardIceThrust as the design load for both directions. Therefore enforce both directional result terms, and propellerShaftDesignThrust, against the same max(forwardExpected, backwardExpected) value within the expected-result-scaled tolerance; do not require the forward result to equal only the forward formula and the backward result to equal only the backward formula.

Remove the guessed sh:datatype xsd:decimal constraint from every qudt:numericValue shape. The canonical metadata declares no datatype for these quantity values, so do not impose one; retain the existing cardinality, QuantityValue class, and declared KiloN unit constraints. The max-based directional design-thrust comparison and expected-result-scaled tolerances correctly preserve the prior instruction.

Preserve the prior max-based directional design-thrust comparison, expected-result-scaled tolerance, and absence of numeric datatype. Repair the DIRECT_CALCULATION SPARQL by removing every ABS(...) call: ABS is not an explicitly permitted calculation operation. Express each tolerance violation with inclusive lower and upper bounds (reported < expected - tolerance || reported > expected + tolerance), using only permitted arithmetic and a simple IF branch for the absolute magnitude of the expected result if needed, with tolerance scaled from the expected formula result.

Candidate faithfully encodes the required ship-level direct calculation: all declared operands and result terms are present with QuantityValue and kN constraints, the forward and backward formulas are correct, both directional design-thrust results and the common design-thrust result are compared to the same max-derived expected value, and inclusive tolerances are scaled from expected results without imposing an undeclared numeric datatype.
